name: pyconjp2026-keynote
description: Slides and materials for Takashi Kitao's PyCon JP 2026 keynote

scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.js tests/*.test.mjs && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests

scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:check && node scripts/wrangler.mjs deploy --strict
